name: Default
shortDescription: Open source newsletter tool for campaigns, contacts, segments and sign-up forms, backed by PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: Sign in with the KEILA_USER email and KEILA_PASSWORD from the environment; they only apply when the root user is first created. Fill in the MAILER_SMTP_* variables for system emails such as password resets. Newsletter senders are configured separately in the Keila UI.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
